credits.title: Credits and data sources
credits.intro: Full legal detail for every source Flyte will use. Attribution never appears on printed OFP or FPL output.
credits.openaipBody: Licence: CC BY-NC-SA. OpenAIP data is not loaded in this version. When it is consumed, attribution will appear only on the map, the route editor, the OFP route section and FPL – not on the logbook, E6B, settings or account.
credits.pansaBody: The official source. Where Flyte and AIP Poland disagree, AIP Poland is right.
credits.weatherBody: NOAA Aviation Weather Center (METAR, TAF, SIGMET). Open-Meteo (winds aloft and elevation). OpenStreetMap for time marks, later.
credits.airacBody: No aeronautical cycle is imported yet. The current cycle will be shown here once the importer exists.
credits.printBody: OFP and FPL printouts carry no licence text, logos or credits.
